args.subject: Group stay inquiry: 10 people in June
args.body:
Hello City Hub Tokyo team,

I'm organising a group stay for 10 people in June and would like to ask about your availability. Could you let me know which dates you can accommodate our group, along with available room configurations, group rates, and any minimum-stay requirements?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
